mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND relative_mission_qualified_at IS NOT NULL )
SELECT difficulty_id FROM tbl_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, mission_title, mission_content, category_id FROM tbl_mission_pool WHERE mission_type = 'ABSOLUTE' AND limit_price = 0 AND category_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY category_id, id

SELECT ROUND(AVG(daily.net_amount), 2) AS base_amount FROM ( SELECT tr_date, SUM(CASE WHEN is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(refunded_amount, amount) ELSE amount END) AS net_amount FROM tbl_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category_id = #{categoryId} AND tr_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND classification = 'CONSUMPTION' AND direction = 'OUT' AND is_excluded_from_summary = 0 GROUP BY tr_date HAVING net_amount > 0 ) daily
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_user_mission_info (user_id, mission_id, difficulty_id, assign_date, target_rate, target_value, base_amount, assignment_reason) VALUES (#{userId}, #{missionId}, #{difficultyId}, #{assignDate}, NULL, 0, #{baseAmount}, #{assignmentReason})
